Method of Attack: Phishing email with fake PDF and Windows shortcut (.LNK) file to deliver malware
Malware collects system information and downloads additional malicious code
Checks for presence of security products (ESET, Tencent, Bitdefender) to evade detection
Persistence by saving malicious file in startup folder
Command Prompt execution to retrieve payload from remote location
Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious attachments (HTML file pretending to be PDF, .LNK shortcut file)
Indicators of Compromise: Email purporting to be from Alex Smirnov with subject about salary changes
HTML file named ‘New Salary Adjustments’ pretending to be PDF
Windows shortcut file (.LNK) posing as plain text file with password
Command to fetch malicious scripts executed via Command Prompt
Overlap in file names and infrastructure with previous Lazarus group attacks
